paite: Ka unaute aw, i i Toupa Jesu Khrist, thupina Toupa gingta kawm in, mite khentuam kei un.
heading: Khentuam Neihna Demna
english: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.

paite: Na kikhopkhawmna inn uah mi dangka-eng zungbuh bun, puan hoihtak silh hong lut henla, huan migenthei puansetak silh hong lut samleh;
english: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue or, meeting , and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in;

paite: puan hoihtak silhmi na limsak ua akiang ah, "Nang hiai mun hoih ah tu in," na chi ua, migenthei kiang ah bel, "Nang huai ah na dingh in, ahihkeileh, ka khe ngakna nuai ah tu in,” na chih uleh,
english: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing, and say, “Sit here in a good place”; and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”;

paite: na lungsim uah khentuam nei leh ngaihtuahna giloupu, gense mite na hong hi kei ding ua hia?
english: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

paite: Ka unau deihtakte aw, Pathian in hiai khovel a gentheite ginna a hau ding leh amah itte kiang a achiam gam luah ding in achi kei a hia?
english: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

paite: Nou bel migentheite na zahlaksak zaw uhi. Mihaute hilou uhia nou hon nuaisiah? Mihaute hilou uhia vaihawmna a nou hon kailut?
english: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

paite: Amaute hilou uhia minhoih na put uh gensete?
english: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

paite: Himahleh Laisiangthou in, "Nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi," chih kumpi dan na zop uleh na hihhoih uhi.
english: However, if you fulfill the royal law, according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” Leviticus 19:18 you do well.

paite: Himahleh mi khentuam na neih uleh, na hihkhial uhi, dan in talekte na hih uh ahon theisak zawta hi.
english: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

paite: Kuapeuh in dan zuikim mahleh mun khat a ahihkhelhleh avek ah siam louh tang in a-om khin hi.
english: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

paite: "Ang kawm ke'n," chipa'n, "Tualthat ke'n," achi lai hi. Huchi in angkawm kei mah lechin tual na thah in, dan a talekpa na hita hi.
english: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” Exodus 20:14; Deuteronomy 5:18 also said, “Do not commit murder.” Exodus 10:13; Deuteronomy 5:17 Now if you do not commit adultery, but murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

paite: Huaiziak in noplenna dan a vai hawmsak dingte bang in thu gen unla, thilhih behlap un.
english: So speak, and so do, as men who are to be judged by a law of freedom.

paite: Zahngaihna suahloumi tuh zahngaihna bei a vaihawmkhum hi ding ahi ngal a. Vaihawmna tung a vualzou zahngaihna ahi.
english: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

paite: Ka unaute aw, mi'n ginna ka nei chi mahleh thilhih aneih keileh bang aphatuam dia? Huchibang ginna in amah ahondam thei dia hia?
heading: Ginna Leh Nasep
english: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

paite: Unaupa hiam, unaunu hiam, vuaktang a om in aniteng an nek tasam le uh,
english: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

paite: na lak ua kuahiam in akiang ah, "Khamuangtak in pai inla, lumtak leh vahtak in om in," chi in asa a ding a thil kiphamoh pe tuan keileh bang aphatuam dia?
english: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace, be warmed and filled”; and yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

paite: Huchi mah bang in ginna leng thilhih nei lou a amah kia a a-omleh si ahi.
english: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

paite: Ahi, mi kuahiam in, "Nang ginna na nei a, ke'n thilhih ka nei hi," na ginna na thilhih pang lou in hon ensak inla, ke'n thilhih in ka ginna ka hon ensak ding achi thei hi.
english: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I by my works will show you my faith.

paite: Pathian khat kia ahi chih na gingta maw? Na hihhoih e; dawite'n leng agingta ua, aling zel uh, achi ding hi.
english: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe, and shudder.

paite: Mithulim lou aw, thilhih pang lou a ginna lel bangmah ahi kei chih na thei nuam hia?
english: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

paite: I pu uh Abraham in maitam tung a atapa Isak alat lai in thilhih ziak a siamtang ahi kei a hia?
english: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

paite: Ginna in thilhih toh asemkhawm a, thilhih ziak in ginna abukimta chih i thei uhi.
english: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected;

paite: "Abraham in Pathian agingta a, huai ginna adiktatna a sim ahi," chih Laisiangthou hihkim in a-om hi; huchi in amah Pathian lawm chih in a-om hi.
english: and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness”; Genesis 15:6 and he was called the friend of God.

paite: Ginna ziak kia hilou in, thilhih ziak zaw in mi'n siam atang zel uh chih na theita uhi.
english: You see then that by works, a man is justified, and not only by faith.

paite: Huchibang in, Rahab kizuaknu'n leng sawltakte ana kipahpih a lam tuam a apaisak lai in, thilhih ziak in siamtang ahi kei maw?
english: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?

paite: Kha pang lou in pumpi si ahih bang in, thilhih pang lou ginna leng si ahi.
english: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
